tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the US cities and counties with building permit data, with each one's slug for the other tools.

tools.name: permits_at_address
tools.description: Use when someone asks what is being built, remodeled or torn down at an address, whether a house had work done with permits, or what construction is going on next door. Returns every building permit on record at that street address in a supported city or county (Los Angeles, New York City, Chicago,

tools.name: permits_near
tools.description: Use when someone asks what is being built near an address or a place: new buildings next door, construction on the block, what's permitted around a home they might buy or rent. Give a city and street address, or a latitude and longitude. Returns building permits within a radius (default 400 meters,

tools.name: get_permit
tools.description: Look up one building permit by its city permit number: work, date, status, cost and address.

tools.name: recent_permits
tools.description: Use when someone asks what is being built in their neighborhood or ZIP code. Returns the newest building permits in a supported city or county, optionally within one ZIP code.
